enchantments.tooltip: Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Armor-Piercing 15%: Passive: +15% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Shrieking II: On Hit: 2 to 8 Sonic Damage.
Improved Vorpal: Passive: +0.5[W] damage dice.On Vorpal Hit: If your target has fewer than 1500 Hit Points, they are instantly slain. If your target has above 1500 Hit Points, they take 150 damage.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
